Package neqsim.process.safety.selfheating

Class BasketTestRegressionResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.selfheating.BasketTestRegressionResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BasketTestRegressionResult extends Object implements Serializable
Result of a BasketTestRegression least-squares fit of hot-storage test data.

Carries the fitted Arrhenius parameters and the quality of the fit. Use createAnalyzer(neqsim.process.safety.selfheating.SelfHeatingGeometry, double, java.lang.String, double, java.lang.String) to feed the fitted parameters straight into a full-scale criticality screening, which is the normal reason for doing the regression: laboratory baskets are small, and the question is always whether the same material is safe at plant scale.

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL

  • Constructor Details

    • BasketTestRegressionResult

      public BasketTestRegressionResult(int pointCount, double slope, double intercept, double rSquared, double activationEnergyJPerMol, double volumetricPreFactorWPerM3, double effectiveConductivityWPerMK, boolean conductivityProvided, List<String> warnings)
      Construct a basket-test regression result.
      Parameters:
      pointCount - number of observations used in the fit
      slope - fitted slope of ln(deltaCrit*Tc^2/r^2) versus 1/Tc, equal to -E/R, in K
      intercept - fitted intercept, equal to ln(E*P/(lambda*R)), dimensionless
      rSquared - coefficient of determination, or NaN if undefined
      activationEnergyJPerMol - fitted apparent activation energy in J/mol
      volumetricPreFactorWPerM3 - fitted volumetric heat-release pre-exponential factor in W/m3, NaN if the effective thermal conductivity was not supplied
      effectiveConductivityWPerMK - effective thermal conductivity used in W/(m K)
      conductivityProvided - true if an effective thermal conductivity was supplied
      warnings - list of warnings; may be null

    • createAnalyzer

      public PorousMediaSelfHeatingAnalyzer createAnalyzer(SelfHeatingGeometry geometry, double characteristicDimension, String dimensionUnit, double boundaryTemperature, String temperatureUnit)
      Build a criticality analyzer pre-loaded with the fitted kinetic parameters, for screening a full-scale body.
      Parameters:
      geometry - shape of the full-scale body; must not be null
      characteristicDimension - characteristic half-dimension of the full-scale body; must be positive
      dimensionUnit - length unit of the dimension ("m", "cm", "mm" or "in")
      boundaryTemperature - boundary temperature the full-scale body is held at
      temperatureUnit - temperature unit ("K" or "C")
      Returns:
      a configured analyzer ready for PorousMediaSelfHeatingAnalyzer.analyze()
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the fit did not resolve usable kinetic parameters
